anti-wear-hydraulic-oil.overview: Blended from refined base oil with anti-wear, anti-oxidation, anti-rust and anti-foam additives.
applications: Medium- and high-pressure hydraulic systems in injection-molding machines, CNC machine tools and construction machinery.
features: Forms an oil film on pumps, valves and cylinders to reduce wear under pressure.
Oxidation resistance, anti-foam and air-release properties support stable operation.
Helps protect metal parts against rust, including during equipment shutdown.
useNotes: Available viscosity grades listed for this family: 32, 46 and 68. Ask for the grade-specific technical data sheet before selection.

slideway-oil.overview: Machine-tool slideway lubricant made from refined base oil with anti-wear, anti-stick-slip, anti-rust and demulsifying additives.
applications: Slideways on lathes, milling machines, grinders and other machining equipment.
features: Adheres to sliding surfaces and helps reduce low-speed stick-slip and wear.
Demulsibility helps separate the oil from cutting fluid.
Provides oxidation resistance and rust protection for machine-tool guideways.
useNotes: Grades 32, 46 and 68 are named in the detailed product information; grade 100 also appears in the category list. Confirm grade 100 availability and request the current data sheet.

fully-synthetic-cutting-fluid.overview: Water-miscible cutting fluid formulated with water-soluble additives and no mineral oil.
applications: Turning, milling and grinding of carbon steel, cast iron and aluminium alloy.
features: Cooling and cleaning action helps carry away cutting heat and metal chips.
Rust protection and a low-foam formula for high-pressure fluid systems.
useNotes: Ask MICONG for the dilution guidance and technical data sheet for the intended process.

semi-synthetic-cutting-fluid.overview: Water-miscible cutting fluid containing a small amount of mineral oil, combining lubrication and cooling.
applications: Turning, milling and drilling of carbon steel, cast iron and aluminium alloy.
features: Helps reduce tool wear while removing heat and chips from the cutting area.
Inter-process rust protection, hard-water resistance and low foaming.
useNotes: Ask MICONG for the dilution guidance and technical data sheet for the intended process.

micro-emulsion-cutting-fluid.overview: Semi-synthetic cutting fluid whose base oil forms fine dispersed particles in water; the diluted fluid appears translucent.
applications: Turning, milling and drilling of carbon steel, cast iron and aluminium alloy.
features: Lubrication, cooling and cleaning characteristics for metal cutting.
Rust protection, hard-water stability and low foaming for high-pressure fluid systems.
useNotes: Ask MICONG for the dilution guidance and technical data sheet for the intended process.
